desc: Read the input string $S$ from standard input.
Construct a new string $T = S + \# + \text{reverse}(S)$, ensuring $\#$ is a character not in the uppercase English alphabet (e.g., '$').
Compute the prefix function (pi array) for string $T$ using the KMP algorithm.
Determine the length of the longest proper prefix of $T$ that is also a suffix of $T$ by looking at the last value of the pi array.
Extract the suffix of $S$ corresponding to this overlap length and append the remaining part of $\text{reverse}(S)$ to $S$ to form the final palindrome.
Print the resulting palindrome to standard output.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Test edge cases: single character, all same characters, completely different characters.
Ensure the solution handles large inputs within time limits (Python's string operations and list comprehensions are efficient enough).
